title: Gideon and the Alibi
author: Lena Montrose
blurb: Edmund Ravensworth, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
